info.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - West Coast
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:
The Senior Clinical Research Associate (SCRA) is primarily a site monitor and is responsible for the management and oversight of their assigned clinical study sites to ensure data quality and patient safety in accordance with ICH-GCP guidelines, local regulations, and applicable SOPs.
The SCRA collaborates with the Clinical Study Teams (CSTs) by supporting day to day clinical study activities, departmental tasks, and provides mentoring to other CRA team members within established protocols and portfolio under general supervision.
Proactively seeks opportunities to lead and drive improvements to optimize effectiveness and efficiencies within the Site Management group as well as within the greater Americas region.
 

Essential Functions of the job:
• Perform and coordinate assigned aspects of the clinical monitoring process in accordance with GCPs and SOPs to assess the safety and efficacy of investigational products and/or medical devices
• Conduct site visits to determine protocol and regulatory compliance, and prepare required documentation
• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites, and study vendors
• Track enrollment status reports to ensure study sites stay on track to meet enrollment goals
• Track study-specific status reports to ensure all required information regarding site issues, deviations, and CRF status are kept current by the monitoring team
• Serve as mentor/trainer for less experienced CRAs to assist with general and study-specific monitoring issues
• Provide direct support to the Clinical Study Manager by assisting with monitoring visit report review and other managerial tasks as needed
• Perform study-specific training with project team
• Develop study-specific monitoring tools and forms for use by monitoring team to assist in efficient review of study data
• Perform Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reconciliation and work with study sites and CRAs to resolve discrepancies
• Review outstanding data reports and work with CRAs to ensure data collection is met per contractual guidelines
• Works with Clinical Trial Oversight Managers (CTOMs) and Clinical Study Team (CST) to manage site trends through dashboard review and ongoing risk assessment to ensure quality standards and address concerns associated with study delivery at sites within established protocols and portfolio under general supervision
• Collaborates with CST and clinical study sites to ensure timely delivery of study milestones (i.e., study startup, recruitment, database analyses, closeout, etc.).
• Provide support for study sites, and CRAs with audits/inspections preparation/responses and quality issues, as needed, and follow-through with audit/inspection findings to resolution as it related to involved CRA staff.
• Assist with other assigned clinical responsibilities within scope of role to provide best practice and/or support to junior clinical staff.
 

Supervisory Responsibilities:
• Provides site level management for established protocols and portfolio under general supervision
• Provides mentoring/support to CRAs for study related topics
• Identification of development opportunities and provides necessary training to for junior team members as needed
• Co-monitoring with CRAs and support site visits, as needed


Computer Skills:
• Efficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
• Familiar with industry CTMS and data management systems


Other Qualifications:
• Understands clinical trial processes with a thorough knowledge of ICH and associated regulatory guidelines
• Minimum of 4-6 years of relevant Clinical Operations experience
• Minimum of 3-4 years of (CRA) monitoring experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO Industry
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multi-task
Travel: up to 40 -60% time
 

Education Required:
BS/BA in a relevant scientific discipline and minimum of 4-6 years of relevant Clinical Operations experience, and minimum of 3-4 years of monitoring experience. Experience in global oncology trials preferred.

info.title: Project Manager, Procurement Technology Solutions
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

This role has hybrid work pattern, 3 days per week from our Warsaw office with 2 days remote.

General Description:

The Project Manager – Procurement Technology Solutions leads end-to-end delivery of procurement and Source-to-Pay (S2P) technology initiatives that improve buying, contracting, supplier enablement, compliance, and user experience. This role partners with Procurement, Finance, GTS, Legal, and external vendors to plan, govern, and execute implementations and enhancements for S2P platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Agiloft CLM, or comparable solutions). The Project Manager owns project outcomes across scope, schedule, budget, RAID management, governance, change control, testing, cutover, adoption, and stabilization/hypercare in a matrixed environment.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead the full project lifecycle for procurement/S2P initiatives (initiate → plan → execute → test → deploy → stabilize)
  • Develop and maintain integrated plans across workstreams, milestones, dependencies, critical path, cutover, and hypercare.
  • Run governance routines (status, steering updates, decision logs) with executive-ready reporting.
  • Own scope, change control, RAID, escalations, and corrective action planning.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Drive alignment across Procurement, Finance, IT, Legal and vendor partners through workshops and structured communications. [apexsystems.com],
  • Manage delivery partners and vendors, including SOW milestones, deliverable acceptance, and issue resolution.

Solution Implementation (S2P / CLM / Procurement Platforms)

  • Lead implementations/enhancements for S2P capabilities (platform-dependent): sourcing, contracting/CLM, supplier enablement, buying, invoicing, and related workflows
  • Coordinate integrations with ERP/Finance systems, data readiness/migration activities, and environment management.
  • Coordinate testing (SIT/UAT), release readiness, deployment, training, and adoption activities.

Quality, Risk, and Outcomes

  • Identify/mitigate risks related to data, security, compliance, operational readiness, and vendor execution; escalate appropriately.
  • Track outcomes and stabilization metrics and drive lessons learned/continuous improvement.

  Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of technology project management experience delivering enterprise solutions (implementation and/or major enhancements).
  • PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project/program certification.
  • Strong delivery discipline: planning, RAID, change control, financial/budget awareness, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external delivery partners/vendors.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC / implementation lifecycle; able to coordinate requirements, testing, deployment, and stabilization.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field; Master’s preferred.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience delivering Finance Technology programs in regulated, global, or highly matrixed environments.
  • Prior implementation experience with SAP Ariba, Agiloft CLM, or comparable S2P/CLM technologies (Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, GEP, Zycus, etc.).
  • Experience with ERP integration coordination and global rollout/change management activities.
  • PMP/PMI-ACP/PRINCE2 certification and/or change management training (preferred). Knowledge of common ERP and finance transformation challenges, including data migration, process standardization, localization, testing coordination, and stakeholder readiness.

General Description:

  • The Manager of Clinical Supply Chain manages drug supply activities related to planning, label development, label & pack, and distribution for one or more clinical programs. Actively develops and oversees supply plans to ensure accurate and continuous supply to patients while reducing risk and minimizing waste. Represents Clinical Supply Chain to internal stakeholders and manages relationships with external supply partners. Works with management to develop and implement process improvements to build the organization for the future.

info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

At BeOne Institute, we extend BeOne’s execution strength with a dedicated innovation engine, bringing agility and scientific depth to transform uncertainty into actionable and high-impact therapeutic opportunities. We operate according to three core principles:  

  • Bold Exploration: we pursue novel and high-potential ideas through rapid, iterative innovation cycles. 
  • Strategic Alignment: we prioritize disease areas that align closely with BeOne’s R&D priorities and long-term vision. 
  • Pipeline Impact: we translate insights into tangible assets and advance emerging platforms into impactful programs. 
     

As a Principal Scientist at BeOne Institute, you will play a key role in conceptualizing, enabling, and driving cutting-edge research at our San Carlos, CA site. As part of your role, you will lead chemistry efforts end-to-end to support exploratory research on new modalities and screening technologies. The ideal candidate will be innovative, bringing creative solutions to both current and emerging challenges, and contributing to brainstorming sessions to propel our research forward. This is a rare opportunity to pursue bold ideas and translate them into real medicines!

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Spearhead chemistry initiatives to facilitate exploratory research on innovative modalities, targets, and screening strategies.
  • Design and implement targeted and diverse compound libraries to test SAR hypotheses and meet project objectives.
  • Develop and apply parallel synthesis techniques to enable swift library creation and iterative optimization.
  • Devise and refine synthetic pathways to ensure efficient diversification and scalability.
  • Utilize structure-activity relationship (SAR) insights to guide and improve compound optimization.
  • Communicate progress through regular updates while proactively identifying challenges and proposing solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-disciplinary or cross-functional teams and drive innovation within and beyond the Institute.
  • Contribute to management and operational activities to support strategic objectives of the BeOne Institute at the San Carlos site.
  • Manage external chemistry teams.
  • Maintain impeccable ELN records.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

  • May be a contact for external CRO partners when needed
  • May provide matrix or line-function leadership for project teams when needed
  • May supervise other associates in the future

Computer Skills:   

  • Candidates are expected to maintain an electronic notebook to a high level of data quality
  • Familiarity with CADD approaches and tools for structure-based drug design, molecular docking, and virtual screening is a plus
  • Familiarity with visual data science tools (eg: Spotfire) is a plus

Required Qualifications:   

  • Ph.D. or equivalent advanced degree in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical chemistry, or a related scientific field, with 6+ years of relevant research experience.
  • Deep expertise in synthetic organic chemistry, preferably in a drug discovery or pharmaceutical research setting.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and synthesizing diverse, project-focused compound libraries to interrogate SAR and biological hypotheses.
  • Strong experience with parallel, convergent, and/or modular synthesis strategies for rapid compound generation and optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute synthetic strategies for novel or challenging chemical matter.
  • Strong chemical intuition, creativity, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify unconventional solutions to challenging synthetic and drug discovery problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate chemistry with biological data and use experimental results to inform compound design and research strategy.
  • Ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple chemistry efforts in a fast-paced, exploratory research environment.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate chemistry strategies, scientific rationale, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work on-site in San Carlos, CA.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with emerging small-molecule modalities, including induced proximity approaches such as molecular glues, bifunctional degraders, or transcriptional modulators.
  • Experience with covalent chemistry and/or covalent drug discovery.
  • Experience designing and synthesizing chemical probes or tool compounds for mechanistic biology.
  • Experience managing external chemistry CROs, including vendor selection, project scoping, technical oversight, and review of deliverables.
  • Experience with CADD, structure-based design, molecular modeling, or computational chemistry.
  • Experience working at the interface of chemistry and biology in exploratory or platform research.
  • Experience establishing, outfitting, or scaling a chemistry laboratory and associated capabilities.

PhD + 6 year of experience

info.title: Associate Director, Portfolio Strategy
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Associate Director, Portfolio Strategy & Decision Intelligence provides the requirements and owns the quantitative and analytical backbone that underpins the R&D portfolio's prioritization, valuation, and analytical interpretation to support governance reviews. This role sits at the intersection of portfolio strategy, data science, and commercial analytics, translating complex, uncertain pipeline data into reports and analyses to support decision-ready insights for senior governance forums.

As BeOne’s portfolio grows in both size and complexity, spanning overlapping indications, combination strategies, biomarker-defined populations, and platform-level dependencies, this role ensures that prioritization decisions rest on a consistent, auditable, and increasingly AI-enabled analytical foundation, rather than ad hoc modeling rebuilt each cycle. This is a newly evolving capability area for the function and offers significant latitude to shape methodology, tooling, and governance standards from the ground up.

 

  • Prior experience in portfolio strategy and management, preferably within a biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences consulting environment
  • Demonstrated fluency in eNPV modeling, PoS-weighted valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and portfolio-level resource optimization
  • Track record of translating complex quantitative analysis into clear recommendations for senior executive or governance audiences
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with credibility among both technical/analytical and clinical/commercial stakeholders
  • Familiarity with decision-support approaches in a pharmaceutical R&D or commercial context

General Description:

The Director, Safety Scientist supports assigned compounds in conjunction with Product Safety Leads (PSLs) and leverages clinical and scientific expertise to lead the detection of safety signals, evaluation of safety data, assessment of safety risks, responses to regulatory inquiries, and regulatory-required periodic reporting. Physicians in this role are also expected to provide medical safety assessment. In this role, you will apply effective prioritization, critical thinking, and judgment-based decision making to execute these key deliverables in compliance with global regulations and internal processes. Effective communication and influence with internal and external stakeholders are important capabilities for this role. This role represents GPS Safety Science internally and externally at a global level and functions as an authoritative and professional member of relevant teams.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Signal and Safety Data Evaluation

  • Lead the identification, analysis, and evaluation of safety signals that arise from multiple internal and external data sources to determine signals or risks that could result in changes to labels and/or benefit-risk profile.

  • Define data acquisition strategy, methodology, and approach for safety evaluations.

  • Perform analysis of safety data and lead authoring of safety assessment 

  • Drive collaboration with PSLs, Safety Scientists, Pharmacoepidemiologists, and cross-functional personnel as appropriate to ensure thorough evaluation and aggregate analysis of safety data, demonstrating the ability to understand and communicate scientific issues and strategy.

  • Lead execution of signal assessment strategy and assess potential impact on the product safety profile with recommendation for action and initiate proposal for Safety Management Team

  • Lead the preparation and presentation of safety data at safety governance meetings (Safety Management Team and Company Safety Committee) and for Safety Monitoring Committee (SMC), Data Monitoring Committee (DMC)/Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB)

  • Apply judgment-based decision-making principles to contribute to key scientific/clinical discussions.

  • Apply effective communication skills to lead and facilitate safety team meetings and drive decision making.

  • Communicate relevant safety information to core team, business partners, and key stakeholders in a timely manner.

  • Lead the development, update, and review of safety communication documents (e.g., Dear Investigator Letter, Informed Consent Form, Investigator’s Brochure, Healthcare Professional communications (DHCP letter or DHPC), Labelling documents, Risk Management Plan, etc.) in collaboration with Safety Science team members and relevant cross-functional team members.

  • Lead signal assessment documentation following BeiGene signal management and safety governance framework.

Clinical Trial Support

  • Lead the review of safety data and monitor the safety of patients on allocated clinical trials.

  • Lead the writing and review safety sections and provide safety expertise for development of Protocols, IBs, ICFs, Safety Analysis Plans (SAPs), Tables Figures and Listings (TFLs), Medical Monitoring Plans, CSRs (incl. China ADR Summary) and other relevant project/study documents and answer ad-hoc safety queries from ethics committees.

  • Lead the authoring and review of safety sections of regulatory submissions, e.g., IND/CTA (General Investigational Plans, China Risk Control Plans), NDA/MAA (SCS/ISS, RMPs, initial Package Inserts) collaborating with PSLs and other Clinical Study Team (CST) members.  

  • Lead the authoring of Storyboards and Briefing Books for HA interactions.

  • Support ad-hoc review of the Safety Management Plans.

  • Lead Safety Science specific investigator training.

  • Risk Assessment, Regulatory Inquiries, and Periodic Reporting.

  • Lead analysis of safety data and author relevant safety sections of global regulatory inquiries and periodic reports including Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), Periodic Adverse Drug. Experience Report (PADER)/ Periodic Adverse Experience Report (PAER), Periodic Safety.

  • Update Reports (PSURs), Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRERs), and Risk Management Plans (RMPs).

  • Lead and demonstrate ability to resource, plan, and fulfill additional evaluation requests with quality from health authorities (e.g., PRAC PSUSA) for assigned compounds. 

  • Identify safety related questions from the review of inquiries and assess the impact to applicable safety documents or safety section of clinical or regulatory documents. 

  • Lead strategy development, analysis, and response to safety questions from health authorities, IRBs/ECs.

Author Health Hazard Evaluations

  • Contribute to integrated Benefit/Risk assessments.

Promote and Advance the Field of Pharmacovigilance

  • Responsible for effective execution, communication and influence with internal stakeholders (e.g., clinical development, medical, regulatory, labeling) and external stakeholders (e.g. FDA, MHRA, EMA, other regulatory agencies).

  • Contribute to continuous employee development programs, such as mentoring, coaching, and peer-to-peer learning.

  • Contribute to and provide Safety Science training to support team development.

  • Identify and develop innovative approaches to continuously improve organizational effectiveness and productivity.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and application of pharmacovigilance principles to related tasks that are high in complexity.

  • Adhere to requirements in quality system document and process improvement initiatives to ensure compliance with internal processes, local laws and regulations.

  • Execute any other tasks assigned by manager to assist in departmental activities.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

  • This position may have direct reports depending on the program / portfolio being led. The Director, Safety Scientist provides key support as an experienced safety scientist that leads and performs high quality and timely scientific, operational, and applicable medical safety analysis. This position works closely with the Safety Science group as part of a matrix team to conduct safety assessment and safety risk management activities per BeiGene process and applicable regulations and provides a high degree of support to assigned compounds and line manager.

Computer Skills:

  • Advanced application capability with Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and electronic document management system (i.e., Veeva)

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.

Education Required:

  • MD (or internationally recognized equivalent) plus accredited residency or have completed a comparable level of post-medical school clinical training relevant to the country of hiring. 4+ years of clinical experience with patients in a relevant therapeutic area specialty, with significant knowledge of general medicine and 6+ years of pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience in Safety Science, Clinical Development, or Clinical Research is preferred

The Head of Global Strategic Feasibility and Study Start-Up at BeOne is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the strategic planning and feasibility assessments for global clinical studies. This individual leads the global strategic feasibility team, works with regional strategic feasibility team, and collaborates closely with cross functional stakeholders while leading a team of Study Start Up documentation specialists to accelerate key study level/asset documentation while driving quality and consistency. The QC Specialist is responsible for coordinating and completing assigned QC reviews, ensuring that clinical and regulatory documents undergo review, copyediting, data verification, and proofreading in a manner that conforms to domestic and/or international regulatory submission and internal document standards, while meeting project timelines. Clinical and regulatory documents include study reports, clinical study protocols or amendments, investigator’s brochures, and the clinical sections of INDs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submission documents. Manages all Quality Control (QC) Chemistry Laboratory – Capillary Electrophoresis (CE) activities to support GMP manufacturing, testing and release of materials, intermediates, and finished products under FDA/EU regulations, applicable International Regulations, BeOne processes and procedures. Establishes and implements QC Chemistry procedures including but not limited to capillary electrophoresis and supports regulatory compliance inspections. Ensures efficient and effective day-to-day operations of the CE laboratory.  This position reports to the Senior Manager QC and is located full-time at the Hopewell, NJ site.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Lead the QC Chemistry (CE) laboratory daily workflow.
  • Establish and maintain QC Chemistry (CE) laboratory related quality systems to ensure conformance with regulations and BeOne Global quality standards.

  • Ensure QC Chemistry (CE) laboratory compliance with Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) standards.
  • Ensure timely completion of testing (e.g., In-process control, DS release, DP release, and stability testing) to ensure timely generation and reporting of test results in support of manufacturing operations.
  • Review of laboratory test results, ensuring adherence to Good Documentation Practices.
  • Ensure appropriate investigation of OOS events, discrepancies, lab errors, and equipment failures.

info.title: Manager, R&D Data Steward
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Manager, R&D Data Stewardship independently leads stewardship activities for assigned R&D data domains and data products. The role ensures data is well-defined, discoverable, appropriately governed, quality-assessed, and fit for intended use while coordinating with business and technical stakeholders.

This individual contributor role applies strong hands-on expertise in metadata and catalog curation, data profiling, data quality, Informatica Data Marketplace, data analysis, automation, and AI-assisted stewardship. The role also coaches other stewards, resolves complex issues, and contributes to stewardship standards and capability improvement.

Essential Functions of the job:

·R&D Data Interpretation & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Interpret complex R&D business processes and data flows independently and translate them into governed metadata, business context, and quality controls.
  • Determine authoritative sources for assigned domains and resolve conflicting interpretations with Data Owners and SMEs.
  • Act as the stewardship point of contact for assigned R&D domains.

·Governance & Standards

  • Lead implementation of R&D stewardship standards, workflows, governance metadata, CDE practices, and FAIR data principles for assigned scope.
  • Independently resolve complex stewardship issues and coordinate decisions with Data Owners, SMEs, Privacy, Quality, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to stewardship metrics, prioritization, standards, and continuous improvement of operating practices.

·Data Context, Cataloging & Metadata

  • Own curation and quality review of business terms, definitions, aliases, taxonomy, CDEs, classifications, ownership, permitted use, and business-friendly descriptions.
  • Drive catalog completeness and consistency in Informatica CDGC and apply working knowledge of ontology and semantic concepts to improve business context.
  • Interpret data models and lineage independently, and coordinate with owning teams when structural or downstream impacts require resolution.

·Data Product & Marketplace Stewardship

  • Lead stewardship readiness, certification, publication, lifecycle review, and recertification of assigned data products in Informatica Data Marketplace.
  • Ensure data products have complete metadata, ownership, business context, quality information, fitness-for-use information, and clear consumer descriptions.
  • Partner with Data Owners and consumers to address data product usability, trust, and governance gaps.

·Data Profiling & Data Quality

  • Independently perform and review complex profiling, including patterns, keys, anomalies, referential checks, and cross-table relationship discovery.
  • Translate R&D business logic into data-quality rules, thresholds, severity levels, and monitoring expectations with appropriate SMEs.
  • Lead investigation, disposition, root-cause analysis, and remediation coordination for significant data-quality issues, and coach others through complex cases.

·Data Analysis, Automation & Platforms

  • Use SQL, Databricks, Python, and PySpark to analyze data, validate stewardship outcomes, and automate repeatable profiling, DQ, metadata, and governance activities.
  • Apply working knowledge of APIs, Git, testing, data engineering practice, and Bronze, Silver, and Gold data foundations to collaborate effectively with technical teams.
  • Identify automation opportunities and define fit-for-purpose controls and validation for stewardship workflows.

·AI-Enabled Data Stewardship

  • Apply approved GenAI and LLM capabilities, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows to profiling, metadata, cataloging, context generation, and DQ activities.
  • Review and validate AI-generated recommendations, establish appropriate human oversight for assigned scope, and coach others on responsible use.
  • Contribute to practical AI-agent and semantic use cases in collaboration with modeling and technology teams.

·Compliance & Risk Management

  • Apply established GxP, privacy, sensitivity, retention, data-integrity, and permitted-use controls to assigned stewardship scope and escalate policy interpretations when required.
  • Ensure stewardship evidence and documentation support audit readiness, traceability, and appropriate risk management.

·Leadership & Capability Development

  • Coach less-experienced stewards, review their deliverables, and support their development against the stewardship skill framework.
  • Lead training or demonstrations for stewardship tools and practices.

·Collaboration, Communication & Enablement

  • Serve as a key stewardship partner for Data Owners, R&D SMEs, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Analytics, and governance stakeholders.
  • Communicate stewardship findings, risks, and decisions clearly to both business and technical audiences.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No - Individual Contributor

Computer Skills:

  • Strong working knowledge of Informatica CDGC and Informatica Data Marketplace.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Databricks with working knowledge of Python and PySpark for analysis and automation.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, Git, testing, and workflow automation.
  • Working knowledge of GenAI and LLMs, prompt engineering, AI-assisted stewardship, and AI-agent concepts.
  • Working knowledge of ontology, semantic data, knowledge graphs, and RDF/OWL/SPARQL concepts, and of data modeling, lineage, and data foundation concepts, sufficient to interpret them independently and collaborate with owning teams.

Qualifications:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver data stewardship, metadata and cataloging, data product, profiling, and data-quality activities in a complex environment.

  • Demonstrated analytical and technical capability using SQL and modern data platforms; automation experience is preferred.

Reporting to the Head/Director of COHERE (Collaborative Operations for Health Engagement. The Associate Director will translate COHERE strategic priorities into actionable approaches across study planning, strategic feasibility, site strategy, patient and community insights, clinical trial education, enrollment support, and performance measurement. The role will leverage data, patient journey insights, site capabilities, and external partnerships to identify and address barriers to clinical trial participation and support informed patient access to BeOne clinical research.

Working cross-functionally across Global Clinical Operations (GCO), Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs, and other relevant functions, the Associate Director will help embed patient access considerations into study planning and execution while building trusted relationships with research sites, healthcare institutions, community organizations, and other external stakeholders.

  • Translate COHERE strategic priorities into scalable operational approaches across BeOne’s portfolio and pipeline.
  • Integrate patient access considerations into early study planning, strategic feasibility, site strategy, study execution, and enrollment planning.
  • Leverage epidemiology, real-world data, patient journey insights, social determinants of health, geographic considerations, and site capabilities to identify barriers and opportunities for patient access.

info.title: Associate Director, Web Technologies Lead
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

This role has hybrid work pattern, 3 days per week from our Warsaw office with 2 days remote.

General Description:

The Associate Director, Web Technologies Lead is responsible for the ownership, performance, and evolution of BeOne’s enterprise web technology ecosystem, with primary accountability for the organization’s global CMS platform (WordPress on Kinsta). This role ensures that web platforms are stable, secure, scalable, and optimized to support Commercial, Medical, and Corporate digital experiences across all markets.

Operating at the intersection of platform engineering, digital experience delivery, and business enablement, this role combines hands-on technical expertise with platform ownership to manage CMS configuration, troubleshoot issues, and establish scalable operating models and standard processes. The Associate Director ensures that web platforms are fit for purpose, aligned to enterprise architecture and compliance requirements, and capable of supporting increasing demands for speed, flexibility, and global consistency.

This role serves as the primary point of accountability for managing the organization’s implementation, development, and production partner, ensuring high-quality delivery, performance, and adherence to defined standards and SLAs. The Associate Director translates business and digital strategy requirements into technical solutions, working closely with Digital Strategy & Enablement, Enterprise Content Systems, Data & Analytics, and other GCMT teams to enable seamless execution of web initiatives.

A key focus of this role is driving technical excellence and operational maturity across web platforms, including governance, release management, integrations, and performance optimization, while continuously evaluating emerging technologies and capabilities to enhance scalability, user experience, and innovation across BeOne’s global web properties.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Enterprise Web Platform Ownership

  • Serve as the enterprise platform owner for BeOne’s global web technology ecosystem, with primary accountability for the CMS, hosting environment, and web platform operations.
  • Own the technical roadmap for enterprise web platforms, ensuring alignment with global business priorities, digital strategy, compliance requirements, and scalability needs.
  • Ensure the CMS platform supports a global portfolio of Commercial, Medical, Corporate, and other enterprise web properties.
  • Monitor platform performance, stability, security, and scalability to ensure reliable delivery of digital experiences across markets.
  • Partner with internal technology teams and external platform partners to plan enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and future-state web capabilities.

CMS Management and Technical Operations

  • Manage the enterprise CMS environment, including WordPress configuration, site structure, templates, plugins, user access, publishing workflows, and technical standards.
  • Oversee the managed hosting environment and ensure appropriate processes are in place for uptime, performance, backups, environment management, and deployment readiness.
  • Provide hands-on technical troubleshooting for CMS, hosting, site performance, configuration, publishing, and content management issues.
  • Establish and maintain standard operating procedures for CMS administration, site updates, releases, issue resolution, and escalation management.
  • Ensure platform configurations support efficient content management, localization, site maintenance, and global reuse across web properties.

Web Development, Release, and Production Management

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of web development, production updates, enhancements, migrations, and new site launches.
  • Define and manage release management processes, including intake, prioritization, testing, approvals, deployment, and post-launch validation.
  • Ensure technical requirements are documented clearly and translated into actionable implementation details for development and production partners.
  • Support structured QA, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and readiness checks prior to launch or deployment.
  • Maintain visibility into development backlogs, timelines, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution across active web initiatives.

Business Requirements and Technical Solutioning

  • Partner with Commercial, Medical, Corporate, Digital Strategy & Enablement, and other stakeholder teams to understand web needs and business objectives.
  • Translate business, content, and digital experience requirements into technical specifications, platform capabilities, and implementation plans.
  • Advise stakeholders on CMS functionality, web platform capabilities, technical feasibility, dependencies, and recommended solutions.
  • Support technical project management for web initiatives, including requirements gathering, scope definition, timeline coordination, risk identification, and delivery tracking.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, globally consistent, and aligned to enterprise web standards.

Web Governance, Standards, and Operating Model

  • Establish and maintain governance standards, operating procedures, and best practices for enterprise web platform management.
  • Define processes for website intake, technical review, prioritization, environment management, production releases, and ongoing site maintenance.
  • Ensure web properties follow approved enterprise standards for CMS usage, hosting, accessibility, privacy, security, analytics, SEO, and content management.
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify roles and responsibilities across website ownership, content ownership, technical support, approvals, and production execution.
  • Define and scale a standardized, templated web delivery model, enabling modular site development, reusable components, and consistent implementation across global web properties.
  • Maintain documentation, process guides, technical standards, and enablement materials to support consistent web operations globally.

Security, Compliance, Accessibility, and Risk Management

  • Ensure web platforms and related processes support enterprise security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and technology teams to assess and address web-related risks.
  • Support implementation of security standards, consent management, cookie compliance, accessibility requirements, and approved third-party technologies.
  • Monitor technical risks related to plugins, integrations, platform changes, vulnerabilities, environment configuration, and production releases.
  • Ensure web operating procedures support appropriate documentation, approvals, validation, and audit readiness in a regulated environment.

Integrations, Analytics, and Web Technology Enablement

  • Support integration of web platforms with analytics, tagging, consent management, marketing technologies, CRM, search, and other digital ecosystem tools.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics, Digital Strategy & Enablement, and tagging/taxonomy teams to ensure web properties support measurement, reporting, and optimization needs.
  • Ensure web implementations support appropriate tracking, data capture, content findability, SEO, and performance measurement requirements.
  • Evaluate technical dependencies across CMS, hosting, analytics, forms, APIs, and third-party services to ensure a connected and reliable web ecosystem.
  • Support improvements that enable better site performance, operational efficiency, content reuse, and digital experience delivery.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate emerging CMS, web, hosting, automation, AI, and digital experience technologies that may improve BeOne’s global web ecosystem.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize web operations, reduce manual effort, improve speed to market, and increase consistency across global web properties.
  • Drive continuous improvement of CMS processes, technical standards, documentation, release management, and partner delivery models.
  • Recommend enhancements to improve scalability, performance, security, accessibility, and user experience across enterprise web platforms.
  • Support the long-term evolution of BeOne’s web technology strategy in alignment with enterprise architecture, digital innovation, and global business needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

  • May have direct people management responsibilities, including oversight and development of technical roles such as a Web Technical Project Manager or similar resources supporting web platform delivery.
  • Provides direction and oversight to cross-functional contributors and project resources supporting web initiatives, including prioritization, delivery coordination, and issue resolution.
  • Establishes accountability across internal and external teams for delivery, timelines, technical quality, and operational excellence across global web properties.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience, preferably in:
    • Information Systems
    • Computer Science
    • Software Engineering
    • Web Development or Web Technologies
    • Digital Technologies
    • Information Technology
    • Business Information Systems
    • Engineering or related technical field
  • Master’s degree (MBA, MS, or similar) preferred.

Computer Skills:   

  • Deep expertise with:
    • Enterprise CMS platforms (WordPress), including site architecture, configuration, plugin management, and troubleshooting
    • Web hosting environments (e.g., Kinsta or similar managed hosting platforms)
    • Web platform operations including deployment, release management, environment configuration, and performance optimization
  • Strong working knowledge of:
    • Web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, and integrations)
    • CMS performance optimization, SEO technical fundamentals, caching, and site speed optimization
    • Analytics, tracking, and consent management platforms (e.g., GA4, tag management, privacy tools)
    • Web security, accessibility (WCAG), and compliance requirements in regulated environments
  • Familiarity with:
    • Headless CMS architectures and modern web development frameworks
    • CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and development workflows
    • Marketing technology integrations (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, personalization tools)
    • AI-enabled web capabilities, automation, and digital experience technologies
  • Proficiency with collaboration and documentation tools (e.g., Teams, SharePoint, Confluence).

Other Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in web technologies, CMS platform management, digital engineering, or marketing technology, preferably in biotech, pharma, or life sciences
  • Proven experience owning and scaling enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress or similar) across a global, multi-site ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of web architecture, hosting environments, performance optimization, and platform operations
  • Demonstrated ability to lead web platform strategy, roadmap development, and operating model design in a complex, regulated environment
  • Experience managing implementation, development, and production partners, including delivery oversight, prioritization, and performance management
  • Experience translating business and digital experience requirements into scalable technical solutions and platform capabilities
  • Strong understanding of web governance, including security, privacy, accessibility (WCAG), and compliance requirements
  • Experience supporting web integrations across analytics, tagging, consent management, and marketing technology ecosystems
  • Demonstrated ability to establish scalable processes, including release management, intake, prioritization, and global web operations
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Commercial, Medical, Corporate, and technology teams
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed, and globally distributed organization

Travel: 

  • Minimal to moderate travel required.

info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Metadata & Taxonomy Analyst is responsible for the configuration, execution, and quality control of content tagging and campaign taxonomy across enterprise content and marketing technology platforms. This role operates at the intersection of content systems and data workflows, ensuring that metadata and tagging structures are accurately implemented, maintained, and validated to support downstream analytics, reporting, and operational processes.

Working within a regulated omnichannel environment, this role executes day-to-day tagging activities, manages Claravine taxonomy templates and validation rules, and ensures proper metadata application within Veeva Vault (PromoMats / Vault Medical). The specialist plays a critical role in maintaining data quality, resolving tagging issues, and supporting system-driven automation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across brands, regions, and agencies.

General Description:

The Senior Content Operations Specialist is responsible for the operational execution and continuous improvement of enterprise content capabilities across Digital Asset Management (DAM), claims management, and content performance reporting. This role ensures that content assets, claims, and associated metadata are accurately structured, governed, and accessible to enable compliant, scalable content creation and reuse across Commercial and Medical organizations.

Serving as a key operational partner to the Associate Director, Enterprise Content Systems, this role focuses on day-to-day management of content libraries, claims repositories, and reporting frameworks within Veeva Vault PromoMats and related systems. The Manager ensures that content and claims are properly tagged, linked, and maintained to support PRC/MRC processes, modular content strategies, and downstream omnichannel activation.

This role plays a critical part in enabling content discoverability, reuse, and measurement by enforcing metadata standards, maintaining data quality, and delivering actionable insights on content utilization, cycle times, and performance. The Manager collaborates cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, GCMT, and agency partners to drive operational excellence, compliance, and data-driven decision-making across the content lifecycle.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Digital Asset Management (DAM) Operations

·Manage day-to-day operations of Digital Asset Management (DAM) within Veeva Vault PromoMats, ensuring content is accurately ingested, tagged, classified, and maintained.

·Enforce metadata, taxonomy, and naming conventions to ensure content discoverability, reuse, and compliance.

·Maintain asset lifecycle governance, including version control, archival, expiration, and reuse eligibility.

·Partner with content owners, agencies, and cross-functional teams to ensure assets are uploaded and structured according to enterprise standards.

Claims & References Management

Content Reporting

oReview and approval cycle times

oAsset utilization and reuse

oClaims usage and distribution

oWorkflow efficiency and bottlenecks

·Analyze content and system data to generate actionable insights that inform process improvements and operational decisions.

·Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and translate business needs into scalable dashboards and metrics.

·Ensure data integrity and consistency across DAM and claims datasets used for reporting.

·Support leadership reporting needs with clear, concise, and actionable summaries of content performance.

Metadata, Taxonomy & Data Quality Governance

info.title: Senior Manager R&D Quality Analytics & Portfolio Insights
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description: 

The Senior Manager R&D Quality Analytics & Portfolio Insights is a specialized R&D Quality role focused on applying advanced analytics, statistical methods, and technology-enabled approaches to strengthen independent Quality oversight of clinical development, participant protection, patient safety, and regulated research activities. This position requires practical expertise in clinical and patient-safety Quality and uses data as a means to identify emerging risks, generate actionable quality insights, and support timely, evidence-based decisions by accountable GCP, GVP, GLP, and GCLP Quality Leads.

The role develops, implements, and maintains fit-for-purpose analytical methods and independent oversight-support tools tailored to regulated R&D activities. These may include statistical monitoring, predictive risk models, anomaly-detection methods, patient-safety and adverse-event reporting analytics, data-informed audit packages, risk indicators, dashboards, automated monitoring, natural-language tools, and other scalable capabilities that support Quality by Design, Risk-Based Quality Management, audit and inspection readiness, vendor, process, and system oversight, and targeted risk mitigation.

The position integrates and interprets complex clinical, safety, laboratory, monitoring, operational, and quality data to identify study-, site-, subject-, vendor-, process-, product-, and portfolio-level signals that may affect participant protection, patient safety, data integrity, scientific reliability, or regulatory compliance. The role translates these signals into clear insights and recommendations for R&D Quality colleagues and cross-functional partners.

Essential Functions of the Job:

R&D Quality Oversight and Risk Analytics

  • Partner with R&D Quality leadership and GCP, GVP, GLP, and GCLP stakeholders to identify priority quality questions, emerging risks, oversight gaps, and opportunities for proactive intervention.

  • Apply quality, regulatory, scientific, and operational context to ensure analytical methods remain relevant to participant protection, patient safety, data integrity, scientific validity, and the reliability of regulated R&D activities.

  • Conduct cross-study, cross-program, cross-vendor, and cross-process analyses to identify recurring, systemic, or portfolio-level risks that may not be visible through individual study or functional review.

  • Develop and maintain meaningful key quality indicators, critical-to-quality factors, quality tolerance limits, risk indicators, thresholds, escalation criteria, and portfolio surveillance methods aligned with RBQM and Quality by Design principles.

Clinical, Safety, and Research Analytics

  • Integrate and analyze relevant clinical study, site, subject, safety, pharmacovigilance, laboratory, monitoring, audit, inspection, vendor, system, and quality data to support R&D Quality oversight.
  • Develop analytical approaches to support data-informed audit planning/execution and identify potential patient-safety and subject-protection risks, including adverse-event under-reporting or over-reporting, unusual clinical-event patterns, protocol-compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and other signals requiring targeted Quality review.
  • Support GLP and GCLP oversight by developing analytics that identify trends and anomalies in research, laboratory, biomarker, sample, method, data-flow, and computerized-system activities, as appropriate to the intended use and available data.
  • Support GVP oversight through analytics related to safety reporting, case processing, signal-relevant quality indicators, vendor performance, timeliness, completeness, and other patient-safety process risks.

Analytical Product Development and Maintenance

  • Translate R&D Quality and business needs into clear analytical objectives, data requirements, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.

  • Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain statistical packages, analytical applications, dashboards, automated workflows, predictive models, and decision-support tools using SQL, R, Python, Power BI, and other approved technologies.

  • Use automation, machine learning, natural-language processing, generative AI, or other emerging methods where they provide a justified, fit-for-purpose improvement

Data Quality, Assurance, and Lifecycle Governance

  • Perform data profiling, mapping, cleaning, transformation, source-to-report reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to confirm the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and reliability of analytical outputs.

  • Ensure analytical and AI-enabled solutions are appropriately governed through documented intended use, data lineage, testing, validation or assurance, access controls, version control, change management, human review, explainability, performance monitoring, and retirement planning proportionate to risk.

  • Maintain appropriate technical and quality documentation to support reproducibility, traceability, inspection readiness, and continued fitness for purpose in a regulated R&D environment.

Partnership, Communication, and Capability Building

  • Create executive-ready visualizations, quality narratives, risk summaries, and recommendations that explain what the data means, why it matters, and what action should be considered.

  • Support Quality Management Review, portfolio quality surveillance, RBQM governance, audit planning, inspection readiness, vendor oversight, computerized-system oversight, and continuous improvement through timely and relevant analytical insights.

  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Data Management, Biometrics, Medical Monitoring, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, laboratory functions, RBQM, Audit and Inspection Management, Global Technology Solutions, data engineering, and enterprise platform teams.

  • Lead or coordinate analytics workstreams from problem framing and data assessment through development, testing, implementation, adoption, monitoring, and benefit realization.

  • Stay current with global R&D regulatory expectations, industry practices, statistical methods, responsible AI principles, and emerging technologies relevant to GCP, GVP, GLP, and GCLP Quality oversight.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, healthcare, or another regulated life-sciences environment, with demonstrated knowledge of R&D Quality, clinical quality, quality assurance, compliance, risk management, or regulated research and development operations.

  • Strong working knowledge of GCP and ICH requirements, with familiarity or experience in GVP, GLP, GCLP, data integrity, computerized-system assurance, and global R&D Quality expectations.

  • Experience with structured and unstructured data, data mapping, data cleaning, reconciliation, transformation, data modeling, automated quality checks, and data pipelines.

  • Experience applying statistical analysis, central statistical monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive modeling, machine learning, natural-language processing, generative AI, or related methods to practical clinical, safety, research, or quality problems.

  • Ability to understand complex R&D Quality and operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions without losing regulatory context, scientific relevance, or business usability.

  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to nontechnical stakeholders and convert complex analyses into concise, actionable quality recommendations.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

No direct people-management responsibility is required at this time. The position may provide technical leadership, coaching, and work direction to analysts, contractors, interns, external vendors, and cross-functional project teams.

Computer Skills:  

  • Advanced proficiency with SQL and hands-on proficiency with R or Python.

  • Experience with Power BI or comparable visualization and business-intelligence platforms.

  • Experience with statistical programming, central monitoring, anomaly detection, predictive modeling, or machine-learning tools and methods.

  • Experience with APIs, data warehouses, cloud platforms, ETL/ELT workflows, Git or comparable version-control tools, and analytical development environments.

  • Experience with automation, natural-language processing, generative AI, or model deployment and monitoring tools is preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with clinical, safety, laboratory, RBQM, audit, and quality platforms is preferred.

Other Qualifications:  

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional, clinical, safety, research, quality, data, and technical teams.

  • Ability to work with sensitive or confidential clinical, safety, quality, laboratory, and patient-level information in accordance with applicable requirements.

info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance to build, enable, and scale enterprise data governance and stewardship capabilities across the organization. This role is a critical position within the Enterprise Data Governance function and is responsible for the day-to-day execution and operationalization of data stewardship across business and data domains operating in a federated governance model.

Working closely with the Head of Enterprise Data Governance, this position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on enterprise data governance and stewardship, translating governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, adoptable processes. This role  will coordinate stewardship activities, lead domain onboarding into the enterprise governance framework, and manage the execution of key governance initiatives, including an enterprise data classification project aligned to the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) Data Security Regulation (Executive Order 14117).

This role will help lead managed service providers and mentor Data Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) team members, track performance, and provide transparent reporting on stewardship progress, risks, and key performance indicators (KPIs). The position requires strong cross-functional partnership with business, IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure trusted, compliant, and well-governed enterprise data assets that support analytics, AI readiness, and regulatory obligations.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Act as a SME for enterprise data governance and data stewardship, contributing to governance operating models, policies, standards, procedures, and best practices.
  • Lead and execute domain onboarding into the federated data governance model, including role enablement, training, and adoption of governance processes and tools.
  • Enable streamlined data discovery and access to data products and assets by implementing an Enterprise Data Catalog & Marketplace.
  • Manage data governance projects and oversee execution of key initiatives, including:
    • Enterprise data classification and tagging aligned to the DOJ Data Security Rule
    • Design and implement workflows for metadata enrichment, glossary curation, and data stewardship, enabling and empowering stakeholders to take ownership of their data.
    • Integrated processes and potentially alternative platforms (Informatica, ServiceNow, Jira)
  • Influence and drive adoption of data governance and stewardship practices without direct authority by partnering with cross functional and domain teams to embed governance into day-to-day execution.
  • Explore opportunities to incorporate emerging AI technologies to streamline data stewardship and governance processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across business, technology, security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to align on shared outcomes, priorities, and acceptable trade-offs.
  • Resolve conflicts and competing priorities by facilitating structured decision discussions, and aligning stakeholders viable governance approaches that balance regulatory risk, data quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Conduct user training and engagement sessions to promote adoption of data governance tools and practices.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on data governance and stewardship KPIs, including domain onboarding progress, steward engagement, metadata coverage, and classification adoption.
  • Report regularly on team performance, initiative status, risks, and outcomes to the Data Governance Lead.
  • Partner with platform owners and architects to ensure effective use of data governance platforms to support stewardship workflows, metadata management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Clear communication skills for explaining data governance essentials to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Author data policies, processes, and procedures per best practice data management standards to support the data governance program, data governance initiatives, and data projects.
  • Pilot new approaches to data governance, gathering feedback to refine and optimize processes.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of data governance initiatives, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Author data policies, processes, and procedures per best practice data management standards to support the data governance program, data governance initiatives, and data projects.

 Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 8+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, or enterprise data management roles.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as a data governance and stewardship SME within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes without formal authority, evidenced by successful adoption of governance processes, standards, or platforms across multiple domains or business units.
  • Experience managing or coordinating data governance projects and initiatives across business and technical teams.
  • Experience driving adoption of governance processes, tools, or standards through persuasion, collaboration, and credibility, rather than mandate.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise data governance platforms - Informatica (IDMC/CDGC/CDQ/CDMP), Atlan, Alation, or equivalent tools and setting those up for optimal adoption by domain. 
  • Comfortable to train data stewards and data owners to effectively use the tool to enhance data governance.
  • Experience with data classification, metadata management, and regulatory-aligned data governance practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate differing incentives across business, IT, security, legal, and compliance functions.
  • Experience mentoring or managing team members, including performance tracking and coaching.
  • Strong ability to translate governance strategy and policy into practical, executable processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience managing and leading the enablement/adoption of Informatica data governance platforms with data stewards in various functions.  (IDMC/CDGC/CDQ/CDMP,AXON)
  • Strong facilitation skills, including leading workshops, onboarding sessions, and governance working groups.
  • Experience governing data as a product within modern data platforms DataBricks, Snowflake.
  • Experience supporting or implementing DOJ Data Security Rule–aligned data classification and tagging programs.
  • Experience with data in a regulated environment, particularly GxP, clinical trial data, or R&D data.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industries is strongly preferred.
  • Experience defining and reporting governance and stewardship KPIs for leadership audiences.
  • Experience with data quality, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems and how stewardship supports downstream use cases.
  • Relevant certifications such as DCAM(Data Management Capability Assessment Model), CDMP, DGSP, DAMA-related certifications, or equivalent experience.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in data management, information systems, analytics, or a related discipline.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

  • Supervisory responsibilities are delivery-focused and include leading and providing direction for our managed service providers on certain projects, while providing strategic oversight and direction to junior data governance resources.

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

info.jobDescription:

  • This leader ensures the analytical control strategy remains robust over the product lifecycle, drives harmonization, and enables reliable supply while meeting GMP, pharmacopeial, and regulatory expectations.

  • The Analytical Technical Lead (ATL) may own relevant global business processes, ensure compliance and efficiency. 
     

Essential Functions of the Job:

A. Global Analytical Point of Contact (PoC) for Approved Commercial Products

  • Act as the global PoC for all analytical-related matters for assigned products, to ensure analytical readiness.

  • Provide governance and technical leadership for analytical topics spanning drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and critical raw materials/reagents as applicable.

It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

info.title: Senior Manager, Sensitive Data Discovery and Governance
info.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

This role has hybrid work pattern, 3 days per week from our Warsaw office with 2 days remote.

General Description:

BeOne is seeking a Senior Manager, Sensitive Data Discovery and Governance to operationalize and scale the enterprise’s sensitive data classification capabilities and support information & records retention lifecycle management capabilities, delivered through the Data Sentinel platform. This role sits within the Enterprise Data & Analytics Governance function and is responsible for the day-to-day execution of sensitive data discovery, classification, tagging, and supports information and record governance across business and data domains operating in a federated governance model.

Working across the Heads of Enterprise Data & Analytics Governance, Information Protection Management, and Information Governance, this position acts as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for sensitive data discovery and classification, translating regulatory requirements into practical, adoptable, and automated governance processes. The initial mandate centers on enterprise sensitive data classification and retention controls aligned to the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) Data Security Program / Data Security Rule (Executive Order 14117), with a forward roadmap that extends these capabilities to GDPR, PIPL, and additional global privacy and records regulations.

Leveraging the Data Sentinel platform, this role will stand up and continuously improve automated sensitive data discovery, classification, labeling, and retention lifecycle workflows; help lead managed service providers; and provide transparent reporting on coverage, risk reduction, and key performance indicators (KPIs). The position requires strong cross-functional partnership with Business, IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Information Governance stakeholders to ensure sensitive data is identified, classified, protected, retained, and defensibly disposed of in accordance with regulatory obligations.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Act as SME for sensitive data classification and information & records retention lifecycle management, contributing to operating models, policies, standards, procedures, and best practices.
  • Operationalize the Data Sentinel platform to deliver automated sensitive data discovery, classification, labeling/tagging, and retention lifecycle workflows across the enterprise data estate.
  • Lead and execute key initiatives, including:
    • Enterprise sensitive data classification and tagging aligned to the DOJ Data Security Rule (EO 14117), including classification schemes and Information Rights Management (IRM) controls for regulated bulk sensitive personal and government-related data.
    • Parterning with Information Governance to operationalize record retention schedules, legal holds, archival, and defensible disposition
    • Roadmap development extending data discovery & classification to other regulatory compliance such as GDPR, PIPL, and other privacy and other regulations.
  • Lead the validation to configure and tune Data Sentinel discovery rules, classifiers, and policies to maximize precision, coverage, and adoption across unstructured and structured data domains.
  • Onboard business and data domains into sensitive data governance processes, including role enablement, training, and adoption of governance tools and workflows.
  • Partner with Information Protection and Privacy to align classification outputs with DLP, access controls, and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate and provide direction to managed service providers supporting discovery, classification remediation, and retention operations.
  • Influence and drive adoption of sensitive data and records practices without direct authority by partnering with cross-functional and domain teams to embed governance into day-to-day execution.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on KPIs — classification coverage, sensitive data exposure and risk reduction, retention schedule adoption, disposition completion, and remediation throughput.
  • Explore opportunities to incorporate emerging AI/ML techniques to improve classification accuracy and automate records lifecycle processes.
  • Provide clear communication of classification and retention essentials to technical and non-technical audiences, and report regularly on initiative status, risks, and outcomes to the Heads of Enterprise Data & Analytics Governance, Information Protection, and Information Governance.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 7+ years of experience in data governance, information governance, records management, data privacy, or sensitive data management roles.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering sensitive data discovery and classification programs within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
  • Hands-on experience with sensitive data discovery/classification platforms — e.g., BigID, Securiti, Microsoft Purview, Varonis, Informatica, or equivalent Data Sentinel–class tooling.
  • Working knowledge of information and records retention lifecycle management, including retention schedules, legal holds, and defensible disposition.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes without formal authority, evidenced by successful adoption of governance processes, standards, or platforms across multiple domains or business units.
  • Experience managing or coordinating governance projects and managed service providers across business and technical teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate differing incentives across Business, IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance functions.
  • Strong ability to translate regulatory requirements and governance strategy into practical, executable processes.

Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in data management, information governance, records/information management, information systems, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of GDPR, PIPL, and other global privacy and records regulations and their classification and retention requirements.
  • Records & information management or information governance certification (e.g., IGP, CRM, ARMA-related).
  • Data governance or privacy certifications such as CDMP, DGSP, CIPP, CIPM, DAMA-related, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with data in a regulated environment, particularly GxP, clinical trial data, or R&D data.
  • Experience defining and reporting sensitive data, classification, and retention KPIs for leadership audiences.
  • Strong facilitation skills, including leading workshops, onboarding sessions, and governance working groups.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Supervisory responsibilities are delivery-focused and include leading and providing direction to managed service providers on classification and retention initiatives, while providing strategic oversight and direction to federated data governance resources.
